intro: Skuerto is a dwarven scout stationed at Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands. Displaced from his home in Ironforge during the refugee crisis, he now aids the Alliance in the field, helping secure ancient magical relics on behalf of Archmage Malin.

sections.t: A Displaced Scout in the Highlands
p: Skuerto previously lived in Ironforge, but was displaced when city authorities made room to house thousands of gnome refugees escaping the radioactive fall of Gnomeregan. Relocating to the field, Skuerto took up work as a scout in the dangerous Arathi Highlands. Stationed alongside Apprentice Kryten at Refuge Pointe, he works under the direction of Archmage Malin to recover arcane reagents and potent magical artifacts that once belonged to Malin's old master, Archmage Trelane.

Despite the harsh conditions of the Highlands, Skuerto takes considerable pride in his wilderness scouting and reacts poorly to anyone questioning his competence. His work regularly brushes up against regional perils, from the hostile Syndicate and Boulderfist ogres to dangerous ancient entities tied to the land. Through his extensive travels and network of acquaintances, he maintains ties with diverse figures across the region, including Shakes O'Breen down at Faldir's Cove and Gerrig Bonegrip in the Ironforge forges.
